title: FatTail Labs Practice Campaign document v1.2
description: First-class Practice Campaign surface (fattail.labs.practice_campaign). Not an afterthought: required fields and campaign stamps are normative for pack green gates. Spec: Specs/FatTail-Labs-Member-Campaign-Concept-Spec-v1.0.md §4.10 / §4.5. Marketing campaigns are out of scope. model 1.2 adds signature, amendments, predecessor_export_key.

model_version.description: 1.0 = Phase 1 MVP. 1.1 = account_export_key, starting_capital, goals_md, activated_at, multi-active (DL-259/096/097). 1.2 = signed_at, signed_terms, amendments[], predecessor_export_key (§4.5).

email.description: Optional. Never used to rebind ownership.

entries.description: Zero or more Practice Campaign rows. Empty array is valid (member never used campaigns).

activated_at.description: When status last entered active (prefill ordering).

account_export_key.description: Portable Trade Log account id matching trade_log.accounts[].id (e.g. acct-12). null = unbound (any/all accounts).

account_label.description: Human label for rebinding when account_export_key is missing on import host.

goals_md.description: Member-authored goals. Platform prompts use process language; member text is free.

is_default.description: Silent book home for the bound account (import no-fuss path). At most one per account.

signed_at.description: Signature clock (ISO). Immutable after first real sign. Null = never signed.

signed_terms.description: Immutable charter snapshot at signature (or backfilled terms).

signed_terms_backfilled.description: True when signed_terms came from migration honesty, not a live sign.

predecessor_export_key.description: Portable id of predecessor campaign (entries[].id). Null for root cycles.

playbook_export_keys.description: M2M playbook entry export_keys (season of practicing identity).

tradeCampaignStamp.description: Required stamp field on trade objects in fattail.labs.trade_log when a campaign link exists. Omit or null when unstamped (valid).

practice_campaign_export_key.description: Must match an entries[].id in practice_campaign surface when non-null.

journalSessionCampaignStamp.description: Required stamp field on journal_session entries when a campaign link exists (OD-1.4).

practice_campaign_export_key.description: Must match an entries[].id in practice_campaign surface when non-null.

memberPackCampaignSurface.description: How practice_campaign sits in fattail.labs.member_export pack.

surfaces.description: Must include practice_campaign when documents.practice_campaign is present. Pack green for campaigns requires this surface + complete entries per campaignEntry.

playbook.description: Import before campaigns so playbook_export_keys resolve.
